image.alt: 斜阳下的建筑天井，原创生成意象

brief.subject: An upward view through a narrow courtyard with two rough sandstone walls, a small opening of pale cloudy sky and a strong diagonal shadow.
brief.action: Sunlight crosses the textured walls while the courtyard remains quiet and empty.
brief.structure: The near walls frame a distant opening, creating a clear relationship between enclosure, height and natural light.
brief.details: Use real coarse stone pores, warm plaster, muted olive shadows and subtle film grain; avoid stylized models and invented signage.
brief.composition: Portrait framing for a full-height half-page crop; preserve the sky opening and the diagonal shadow.

brief.subject: A warm oak chair with a woven natural seat, an ivory linen curtain and a small cup resting on a travertine side table.
brief.action: Side light makes soft shadows across the chair and the nearby limewashed wall.
brief.structure: The curtain edge, chair frame and cylindrical side table create a close sequence of three contrasting materials.
brief.details: Preserve believable furniture proportions, real wood grain, woven fibers and a matte ceramic surface; no glossy model look.
brief.composition: Portrait interior detail with the chair and table kept readable inside a narrow vertical crop.

images.alt: 自然光中的暖色客厅，原创生成意象

brief.subject: A quiet living room with a linen sofa, a warm oak chair, a travertine table, a ceramic bowl and sheer curtains under afternoon light.
brief.action: Light enters from the side and reveals the tactile surfaces of the furniture.
brief.structure: The chair in the foreground, low table and sofa form three related depths inside one continuous room.
brief.details: Keep linen weave, stone pores and wood grain visible, with soft beige walls and natural material imperfections.
brief.composition: A wide eye-level landscape crop, with useful room detail across the frame and no empty artificial margins.

images.caption: 整体空间

images.alt: 设计师手中的材质选择，原创生成意象

brief.subject: Anonymous hands arrange an oak swatch, pale stone tile and cream fabric on a large workshop table, with a pencil and blank papers.
brief.action: The hands compare the touch and edge alignment of three material samples.
brief.structure: The samples lie side by side in an ordered sequence while the hands connect them through one visible selection action.
brief.details: Use real skin anatomy, natural wood grain, uneven stone pores and fine fabric weave; no readable labels or technical drawing text.
brief.composition: Wide oblique overhead crop focused on hands and materials, preserving all fingers and the active selection area.

images.caption: 材料讨论

images.alt: 石材、亚麻与陶器的材质静物，原创生成意象

brief.subject: Two stone samples, a dark upright slab, folded oatmeal linen and a small ceramic vessel with a dry branch on a tan table.
brief.action: Afternoon light grazes the objects and reveals differences in their tactile surfaces.
brief.structure: Objects of different heights form an asymmetric grouping on the right, with a quiet open tabletop to the left.
brief.details: Show rough stone edges, fine linen weave, matte pottery and restrained warm browns; all objects are full-scale and real.
brief.composition: Landscape still life, preserving the whole vase and upright slab; allow a portrait crop of the grouping if needed.
